headline: Libya Removes International Aviation Restrictions After 11 Years
summary: Libya's transport ministry announced that airspace restrictions issued by the UN's International Civil Aviation Organization in 2015 have been removed.
why: Lifting international aviation bans normalizes commercial transport links, supporting business travel, tourism, and economic integration for North African markets.

impacts.name: Aviation
impacts.why: Reopened airspace allows commercial airlines to resume direct routes, lowering logistical costs and travel barriers.
